outcome.definition: Any baseline radiographic knee OA. OAI code 0 is neither knee; codes 1, 2, and 3 indicate right, left, or both knees.

features.frequent_knee_symptom_status: P01KSX - person-level frequent knee pain status
features.prior_knee_injury: P02KINJ - prior knee injury severe enough to impair walking for at least one week
features.family_history_knee_replacement: P02FAMHXKR - blood relative with knee replacement
features.frequent_stair_climbing: P02PA1 - climbs at least 10 flights of stairs on most days
features.frequent_kneeling: P02PA2 - kneels for 30 minutes or more on most days
features.frequent_deep_knee_bending: P02PA3 - squats or deeply bends knees for 30 minutes or more on most days
features.koos_pain_worse_knee: Minimum of V00KOOSKPR and V00KOOSKPL; lower KOOS means worse pain
features.flexion_contracture_worse_deg: Maximum non-negative flexion contracture from V00RKFHDEG and V00LKFHDEG

safety: No radiographic source field is retained as a predictor. This data is suitable for research screening model development, not clinical deployment.
